pluginText.pf.questions: {"beforeTimes":["new or returning","the instrument (or voice), and the length: 30 or 45 minutes (60 for audition prep)","the level: never played, beginner, or plays already","at the studio, at home or online","a trial lesson, a single lesson, or weekly lessons"],"afterTime":["anything the teacher should know that isn't private (a piece the student is working on, an instrument at home or not)","for a home lesson: the address, parking, and where the piano or a quiet room is"],"securePage":["the student's first name and age","18 or older, and the parent or guardian of a student under 18","any learning, health or hearing notes the teacher should know (optional)","who may pick up a student 10 or older (the pick-up list)","photos or video at lessons and recitals: yes or no","the first name to print in a recital program, only with the parent's yes"],"whoMayBook":"an adult for themselves or another adult; a parent or guardian for a student under 18, from age 5; a teen who books is asked to send the link to a parent"}
pluginText.pf.safety: {"stop":[{"words":"a student hurt or very unwell at a lesson: hard to breathe, a fall, an allergy reaction","say":"Call 911 now. The teacher stays with the student.","booking":"the lesson stops; the parent and Sam are told at once"}],"goOn":[{"words":"a student who's sick or has a fever before a lesson","what":"the lesson moves free, or goes online, as the studio's rules say"},{"words":"words that a child may be unsafe","what":"sent to Sam at once, privately, and to the authorities where the state's rules require it; never answered by the AI"}],"always":"the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking"}
pluginText.pf.first_steps: {"steps":"none: a trial lesson is booked as its own lesson, never as a step before another","prep":"for the reminder: bring the instrument (violin, voice music) and the lesson book; for a trial, the teacher brings a loaner violin and checks the size; a student under 10 comes with a parent, who stays in the building; for a home lesson, a quiet room with the piano"}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"checkIn":"at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk or the lesson room door; at home: the code from the adult who answers the door; online: the code read out at the start of the video call","minors":"under 10: a parent or guardian stays in the building; 10 and older may wait alone and go home only with an adult on the pick-up list; at home: an adult stays home for the whole lesson; lesson room doors have windows","beforeWork":"the teacher checks what the student practiced and the piece in the notes from last time","changes":"more time (an extra 15 minutes) only if the teacher is free next, priced and OK'd first; a late student gets the time left, and the lesson ends on time","done":"the check-in code, or DONE from the teacher; the teacher's practice notes go to the parent on a private page"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"a card saved for the $20 fee (the studio) or the $40 fee (home lessons); a trial paid in full; a term or the first month of a monthly plan paid in full on the page","after":"each lesson charged to the saved card after it, or paid at the front desk where Sam sets it","caps":"deposit and prepay caps: from the state form","cancel":"free to cancel or skip until 24 hours before (the owner's setting)","fees":"a late cancel or no-show: $20 at the studio, $40 for a home lesson, a trial's $25; the owner confirms each one, and no answer means no fee","makeups":"a lesson missed with 24 hours' notice, a teacher out or the studio closed: a make-up within 30 days, or a refund for a prepaid lesson; a late cancel or no-show: no make-up unless Sam offers one; never a fee when the studio changes the plan","plans":"weekly lessons and the monthly plan need their own yes; 30 days' notice of a price change; stopped by one reply or on the page; a yearly reminder of the terms where the state's rules require it","tips":"none: the studio takes no tips, and Rosie never asks for one","tax":"a tax line only for books or strings sold, where the state's rules require it","fee2":"Rosfield's $2 applies: once a month for a plan, once for a recital spot"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never":"a student's age, school, learning, health or hearing notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page; texts name a student by first name only","minors":"a student under 18 gets no texts: they go to the parent or guardian who booked","selling":"no instrument rentals, sales or offers in booking texts; renting an instrument is between the family and a shop","languages":"English and Spanish"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"none for teachers","skills":"each teacher's instruments and the ages they teach; only teachers of an instrument are offered for it (only Elena teaches violin at the example studio)","checks":"a background check on file before teaching students under 18, where the state's rules or the owner require it","supervision":"a student teacher or assistant teaches only while a teacher is in the building, where the owner sets it","oks":"Sam OKs home lessons from the studio, a new student's first lesson at the studio, same-day lessons, and any make-up past 30 days","standIn":"a stand-in teaches the same instrument, with the last lesson's notes"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"plans":"repeat plans: the price, how often and how to stop sit next to their own yes; reminders and notice periods where the state's rules require them","minors":"who must stay with a minor, and background checks for people who teach minors, where the state's rules require them","photos":"a minor's photo, video or name in a recital program only with the parent's yes","records":"lesson notes and the booking kept 7 years, or as the state's rules say","receipt":"what a receipt must show, where the state's rules require it"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"lateArrival":"the lesson ends on time; no make-up for lost minutes","teacherLate":"a teacher running late gives the full lesson, or a new time with no fee","missed":"a late skip or no-show: Sam decides the fee and any make-up; no answer, no fee","makeup":"make-ups are offered by text with times to pick; Sam is asked before one runs past 30 days","closure":"snow or a teacher out: every family gets a new time or a refund, never a fee","recital":"a recital is set on a date that can't move: families sign up on a page, get the order and call time, and check in at the door; a teacher out that day gets a stand-in accompanist","pickUp":"a student 10 or older goes home only with an adult on the pick-up list","other":"all other edge cases the generic way","leftEarly":"the example studio's own rule: a student who leaves early is charged the lesson as booked; Sam can lower it with PART"}
